caption: The AI Assistant widget with its three tasks
preconditions: Seeded demo data (SEED.md): ELECTION-BUDGET exists in Politics / Working, unpublished and not locked

The e2e client loads the ai-widget extension with stub generateHeadlines, generateSummary and translations.generateTranslations (CAPTURE.md, 'e2e client patch'); the stubs return the texts quoted in the next three entries
The Story content profile does not hide the 'Ai Assistant' widget (Settings > Content Profiles > Story > Widgets)
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
Double-click the item with slugline 'ELECTION-BUDGET' in [data-test-id="monitoring-group"][data-test-value="Politics / Working"] to open it for editing
Wait for [data-test-id="navigation-tabs"] to be visible
Click [data-test-id="authoring-widget"][data-test-value="Ai Assistant"]
Wait for [data-test-id="authoring-widget-panel"][data-test-value="Ai Assistant"] to show the buttons 'Headlines', 'Summary' and 'Translations'
notes:
The demo stack has no AI service and the default host build does not load ai-widget. The e2e/host client index must add {id: 'ai-widget', load: () => import('superdesk-core/scripts/extensions/ai-widget').then((ext) => { ext.configure(() => ({generateHeadlines: () => Promise.resolve([...]), generateSummary: () => Promise.resolve('...'), translations: {generateTranslations: () => Promise.resolve('

...

'), translateActionIntegration: false}})); return ext; })}. Use the same stub texts as the next three shots. Without configure() the widget is not registered and a red 'You haven't registered any services for the Ai Assistant Widget!' toast appears on load. The widget label in the UI is spelled 'Ai Assistant'.

caption: Suggested tags in the iMatrics tagging widget
preconditions: Seeded demo data: ELECTION-BUDGET in Politics / Working, unpublished, not locked, with no iMatrics tags saved
The client build loads the auto-tagging-widget extension
User preferences run_automatically and show_images are off (the defaults)
steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and select desk 'Politics'
Double-click the item with slugline 'ELECTION-BUDGET' to open it for editing
Click [data-test-id="authoring-widget"][data-test-value="iMatrics tagging"]
Wait for the text 'No tags yet' in [data-test-id="authoring-widget-panel"]
Click the button with text 'Run'
Wait for the buttons 'Save' and 'Cancel' to be visible in the widget header and the button 'Refresh' at the bottom
highlight: the tag groups, the 'Save' and 'Cancel' buttons, and the 'Run automatically' switch
notes: The demo stack has no iMatrics account, so the capture has to mock POST **/api/ai/ (body {service: 'imatrics', ...}) with page.route. Suggested response: {"analysis": {"subject": [{"name": "economy, business and finance", "qcode": "04000000", "scheme": "mediatopic", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "04000000"}}, {"name": "government budget", "qcode": "20000565", "parent": "04000000", "scheme": "mediatopic", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "20000565"}}, {"name": "Elections", "qcode": "imx-elections", "scheme": "imatrics_topic", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "imx-elections"}}], "person": [{"name": "Ilse Marrow", "qcode": "imx-p1", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "imx-p1"}, "description": "Finance Minister of Aldmark"}, {"name": "Aron Pellow", "qcode": "imx-p2", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "imx-p2"}}], "organisation": [{"name": "Civic Union", "qcode": "imx-o1", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "imx-o1"}}, {"name": "National Assembly", "qcode": "imx-o2", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "imx-o2"}}], "place": [{"name": "Arlenport", "qcode": "imx-pl1", "source": "imatrics", "altids": {"imatrics": "imx-pl1"}}]}}. The capture tool has no route-mock support yet (CAPTURE.md lists no such extension), so this shot needs a small addition to capture.mjs or a stack with a real iMatrics account. Do not click Save: it writes the tags to the item and POSTs feedback to /api/ai_data_op/. Group titles without iMatricsFields config show the raw scheme ids ('mediatopic', 'imatrics_topic', 'entities'); set appConfig {"iMatricsFields": {"entities": {}, "others": {"mediatopic": {"name": "Media topics", "order": 1}, "imatrics_topic": {"name": "Topics", "order": 2}, "entities": {"name": "Entities", "order": 3}}}} for readable titles.
skip: auto-tagging-widget is not loaded in the e2e client: it adds an empty IMATRICS field to the header of every authoring view (which would change every other authoring shot), and its build rewrites the tracked scripts/extensions/auto-tagging-widget/package.json. Needs a build that loads the extension, plus a mocked POST /api/ai/ (mockRoutes).

caption: Editing a provider and choosing its models
preconditions: The 'OpenRouter' provider exists (seeded by seed.py, AI_PROVIDERS)
GET **/api/ai_providers/*/models is answered by the entry's mockRoutes with the four model names, so Default model is a select and Available models is editable
steps: Open #/settings/ai-providers and wait for [data-test-id="ai-providers-page"]
notes: Without the models mock the demo stack cannot reach the provider: Default model turns into a text input with a warning ([data-test-id="gform-message--default_model"]) and Available models is read-only, which is not the state the caption describes. The e2e spec ai-providers.crud.spec.ts uses page.route for exactly this. The capture tool has no route-mock support yet, so this needs a small addition to capture.mjs. Do not save the form.
